title: Chapter 2772 - 110: Foreign Invaders (3)
content:
Chapter 2772: Chapter 110: Foreign Invaders (3)

Moreover, this kind of heavy armor is indeed strong, but after all, the quantity is limited.

Bi Fang Tribe and Shugu Tribe, the forces of the two main departments, along with dozens of Golden Core Barbarian Generals, are not at a disadvantage in a head-on confrontation.

Bi Jie had long made arrangements for this.

The two sides clashed together.

The Golden Core of Bi Fang Tribe led the Barbarian Soldiers of Bi Fang Tribe, entangled with these Bone Heavy Armor Soldiers.

Others, along with Bi Jie, desperately surrounded and attacked Dan Zhu.

In the Second Grade Mountain Realm, Dan Zhu was unable to use his Magic Treasure, making him at a great disadvantage. After fighting for a while, he was indeed defeated again.

Dan Zhu continued to flee.

Bi Jie continued to pursue.

As they chased, seeing Dan Zhu about to be driven to a dead end, a squad of heavy armor soldiers from Shugu Tribe suddenly emerged from the woods.

This squad of heavy armor soldiers, a total of twenty people, were all wearing Bone Heavy Armor, with superior Shugu war makeup painted on their faces.

These were elite soldiers.

The leader was a Golden Core, with a stern bone pattern on his face, seemingly very orthodox, clearly a Golden Core from Shugu Tribe.

He shouted, "Young Master Bi Jie, I am ordered by General Lugu to assist you in killing Dan Zhu!"

Bi Jie felt a surge of joy and said, "Good! Join me in killing Dan Zhu; today is the day Dan Zhu dies!"

The heavy armor soldiers of Shugu Tribe surrounded Dan Zhu.

The Golden Core of Shugu Tribe took the opportunity to stab Dan Zhu to the ground with a Bone Spear.

In Bi Jie’s heart, he felt a sense of discord, something seemed off.

But Dan Zhu, who fell to the ground, bleeding from the shoulder, pale-faced, and in a panicked expression, was more "enticing" than the most beautiful woman in the world.

Bi Jie’s desire for revenge burned fiercely, losing his sense of rationality, ignoring everything else.

He wanted to personally kill his enemy, making Dan Zhu die in humiliation.

Bi Jie stepped forward boldly, drawing his sword as he approached Dan Zhu.

But before he could get close, a Bone Spear, laced with deadly poison, suddenly stabbed from a blind spot behind him.

Bi Jie, naturally suspicious and cautious, noticed the danger at the last moment and activated his movement technique to dodge the spear.

However, the poison on the spear still grazed Bi Jie’s cheek.

Suddenly, Bi Jie felt an inexplicable sense of hunger.

Before he could react, he felt a scorching sensation from his side.

The previously fallen and haggard-looking Dan Zhu now had cold eyes filled with killing intent, wielding a Vermilion Bird Fiery Fire Spear, directly aiming for Bi Jie’s ear portal.

Bi Jie clearly did not expect that the normally upright Dan Zhu had learned to "ambush" him.

This spear was strong and fiery, and the angle was tricky, as if meticulously calculated, leaving Bi Jie unable to completely dodge.

Just then, a Golden Core from Bi Fang Tribe rushed forward, blocking the spear for Bi Jie, piercing through his chest.

Bi Jie quickly retreated, temporarily escaping Dan Zhu’s killing intent.

But before he could breathe a sigh of relief, more than twenty heavy soldiers from Shugu Tribe, with White Bone makeup on their faces, suddenly turned their guns towards him, surrounding him.

Bi Jie became furious, "How dare you?! Shugu Tribe, do you dare betray the alliance?"

Yet these heavy armor soldiers remained silent, all the while attacking Bi Jie.

Dan Zhu also urged his spear, his body like a blaze, killing towards Bi Jie.

Bi Jie endured the subtle strange hunger, starting to tussle with Dan Zhu and over twenty heavy armor soldiers.

But he could only desperately protect his life, having no chance to retaliate.

Bi Jie was furious, but a moment later, he couldn’t help but reflect deeply:

What exactly is happening?

Did Lugu betray the covenant?

Or is Dan Zhu, this kid, are they "acting" to deceive me?

Could these Barbarian Soldiers with White Bone makeup and wearing Bone Heavy Armor be "disguised" by the Danque Tribe?

But reality would not give him much time to think.

Seeing that they couldn’t easily defeat Bi Jie, Dan Zhu and the others began to shift their focus, aiming their slaughter towards other members of Bi Fang Tribe.

In less than a hundred rounds, a Golden Core was severely injured.

Moreover, more than twenty Foundation Establishment Barbarian Soldiers died under the Bone Spear.

The "Shugu Tribe’s" Bone Heavy Soldiers joined forces with Dan Zhu to slaughter Bi Jie’s followers.

No matter what the truth is, at least what he sees before his eyes is this scene.

Bi Jie was furious.

At this moment, he suddenly remembered something:

The secret of the ancestor’s heavy armor, is it really that easy to leak?

Even if it’s leaked, who could recreate such ancient heavy armor?

Could this have been a ploy by Lugu from the beginning?

He’s long been in cahoots with Dan Zhu, even lending the Heavy Armor to the Danque Tribe.

The two of them are "setting a trap," aiming to lure him in and swallow up his Bi Fang Main Department, and kill him, the Young Master of the Bi Fang Tribe.

Bi Jie felt cold sweat trickling down his heart, the more he thought about it, the more plausible it seemed.

If not, how could a dignified Shugu Main Department fail to conquer even a Second Grade Mountain Realm?

Lugu, the Late Golden Core Stage General, couldn’t defeat a Second Grade Mountain Realm or Dan Zhu?!

All these are suspicious points.

Previously, Bi Jie was solely focused on killing Dan Zhu, wanting to capture and torture him, without thinking deeply.

Now, stimulated by the scene before him, his suspicions arose, and these questionable "flaws" become entirely exposed.

"Lugu and Dan Zhu, those bastards, colluding with each other! They’re trying to lure and kill me!"

Bi Jie panicked.

The Bone Heavy Armor Soldiers before his eyes were awe-inspiring.

The Heavy Armor Soldiers from the Danque Tribe and the "Shugu Tribe" merged and charged at Bi Jie together.

"Two tribes wearing the same Heavy Armor!"

"Damn it!"

Bi Jie gritted his teeth and said, "Retreat!"

If he doesn’t retreat now, once Lugu charges again, his life is as good as lost.

Bi Jie immediately led the troops to retreat, halfway discovering some campsites along the way were all breached.

Shugu Barbarian Soldiers were grabbing the supplies from his Bi Fang Tribe.

This was also Mo Hua’s command.

During the battle, all the supplies in the Bi Fang Tribe’s camps, Danque Tribe’s Barbarian Soldiers are prohibited from taking; they should tear open Storage Bags, smash open Storage Boxes, toss the supplies on the ground for Shugu Tribe people to loot.

People from the Shugu Tribe will surely loot.

These Barbarian Cultivators don’t have strict discipline.

If the supplies are stockpiled in the camps, they might not move, but if tossed on the ground, they can’t resist greed.

This is not Mo Hua ordering people to "pretend," but real "Shugu Soldiers" looting Bi Fang Tribe’s supplies.

Bi Jie was enraged and immediately ordered his men to kill those Shugu Barbarian Soldiers looting the supplies.

By killing them, the Golden Core from the Shugu Tribe saw it.

They began to accuse Bi Jie, angrily saying, "Young Master Bi Jie, killing our Shugu Clan people, what is the meaning of this?"

Bi Jie sneered, "That’s something you should ask your General Lugu, why he wants me dead?"

Shugu Tribe’s Golden Core angrily replied, "You wrongdoer accusing first, shameless to the extreme!"

Bi Jie couldn’t speak yet.

Then suddenly, among the crowd, a batch of "Bone Heavy Armor Barbarian Soldiers" with White Bone War Paint on their faces charged out, attacking Bi Fang Tribe’s Barbarian Soldiers without saying a word.

The rest of the Shugu Barbarian Soldiers instinctively followed these "Shugu Heavy Armor Soldiers" and began slaughtering the Bi Fang Tribe.

They were already angry, and now seeing their "ancestral heavy troops" venting for their people, naturally, they won’t hold back.

Seeing this scene, Bi Jie confirmed his thoughts, even angrier:

"Sure enough, you’re all in it together! Damn it, you all deserve to die!"

Someone in the crowd shouted:

"Kill!"

"Kill!"

More and more people began to echo this.

The situation instantly turned more chaotic.

No need for Bi Jie to give orders; Bi Fang Tribe and Shugu Tribe’s Barbarian Soldiers started killing each other, looting from one another.

They were different tribal Barbarian Cultivators by nature, with no shred of camaraderie between them.

If there’s no conflict, they can barely fight together.

But now, seeing blood, looting, having grudges, it’s like a firecracker being lit, exploding all at once.

Bi Fang Tribe kills Shugu Tribe’s people, Shugu Tribe counterkills.

Shugu Tribe loots Bi Fang Tribe’s things, Bi Fang Tribe counterloots.

You kill and I loot, you loot and I kill—adding a group of "Shugu Tribe Heavy Armor Soldiers" leading the charge, chaos instantly enlarges, conflicts spread outwards.

Before attacking Wutu Mountain Realm, the alliance of Shugu Tribe and Bi Fang Tribe turned on themselves.

Smoke wafted everywhere inside the Wutu Mountain Realm.

Mo Hua stood on high, watching all this from afar, thinking ’indeed.’

"Law, such a thing, applies everywhere."

"This trick is quite useful, need to learn to utilize conflicts more, sow discord..."

"Understanding the world is learning, not only using Formation for Enlightenment but also using precise people and events for Enlightenment..."
